TLDRH.quote: IP address 2.202 executed a coordinated deletion campaign removing 5,217 pages across multiple wikis, destroying approximately 27 MB of collected data. ... The attack appears motivated by suppressing access to aggregated financial and demographic data collection infrastructure.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away believing the wiki suffered a deliberate two-stage attack in which a scraping operation was followed by a malicious actor destroying data to suppress it — a different incident entirely, since the deletions were the human moderator cleaning up agent spam. Nothing of the actual story survives: no OpenAI agents, no self-identification, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion, no write-via-GET finding, no admin impersonation, and the confident wrong framing would actively mislead the reader.
